# Wubble

> Wubble is an independent web studio and Webflow Certified Partner from the Netherlands, working worldwide. Wubble designs and builds fast, motion-rich websites with real-time 3D, and keeps them growing with monthly Webflow plans.

Contact: hello@wubble.nl

## Services

- [Webflow Development](https://wubble.nl/services/webflow-development): Webflow sites and Webflow retainers for ongoing design and development: Care $950 (up to 8 hours), Growth $2,750 (up to 24 hours), Partner $4,950 (up to 40 hours) per month.
- [Web & UX Design](https://wubble.nl/services/web-ux-design): web and UX design that gets built: designed in Figma, built in Webflow. Website packages: Premium Webflow Website $2,500, Premium Business Website $4,500, Full Premium Experience $7,500.
- Shopify Development: custom Shopify themes, headless commerce, checkout and conversion tuning.
- AI Integration & Automation: AI features inside websites, workflow automation, visibility in AI search.
- Creative Development (WebGL & 3D): real-time 3D on the web with Three.js and GSAP.

## Facts

- Clients include Nertia, Orrett's, Luis Brown, Foedsie, LegalPa and Wiwi.
- Websites start from €2,500, with a fixed quote once the goals are clear.
- A focused website takes 6 to 10 weeks; larger brand and product work 3 to 4 months.
- Wubble is a one-person studio: strategy, design and development stay with one designer-developer, with no outsourcing.
